title.zh: v2.0.51 手机端触控目标放大：轨道行控制从 20px 提升到 36px，静音/独奏不再需要精准点击
title.en: v2.0.51 Larger Phone Touch Targets: Track-Row Controls 20px → 36px, No More Precision Tapping

highlights.zh: **轨道行控制触控目标 20px → 36px**：试听、静音、独奏、检查器、折叠、移动等八个按钮此前在手机上只有 20×20px，而人手指的可靠触控面积约 44px、可接受下限约 32px——静音和独奏是编曲时最常点的两个按钮，却最难点中，误触还会改错轨道状态。现在手机端为 36×36px（桌面端保持 16px 不动，因为鼠标精度足够且工具栏已经很拥挤），仍能在一屏内放下 8 条轨道。
highlights.en: **Track-row controls 20px → 36px**: the eight buttons in each row (audition, mute, solo, inspector, fold, move) were 20×20 px on a phone, while a finger needs about 44 px and tolerates no less than ~32 px. Mute and solo are the two most-tapped controls when arranging, and they were the hardest to hit — a miss also changed the wrong track's state.
